content: OpenTelemetry Python 1.45.1 (SDK) + API 1.45.1 (already installed via mcp 2.3.0). For OFFLINE span export with no collector there is an official OTLP JSON File Exporter (opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-json-file 0.66b1, beta): from opentelemetry.exporter.otlp.json.file import FileSpanExporter; pair with SimpleSpanProcessor/BatchSpanProcessor to write compact JSON-Lines spans to a file. ConsoleSpanExporter also exists. OTLP HTTP/gRPC exporters require a collector/backend. LangSmith is SaaS by default (egress); langsmith 0.14.5 is installed transitively but must stay disabled (enabled='local' or unset) to preserve no-egress.
